opps.note: 长处 is a strong point and 短处 is a weak point. Both end in 处 (place), and 长 and 短 are long and short.
Long term and short term. Both end in 期 (period), and 长 and 短 are long and short.
Greater than and less than. 大 is big and 小 is small.
The opening and the closing ceremony. 开 means open and 闭 means close.
Outside and inside. Both end in 部 (part), and 外 and 内 are outside and inside.
In the sky and under the ground. 天 is sky and 地 is earth.
Subjective and objective. Both end in 观 (view). 主 is the host and 客 is the guest.
Favourable and unfavourable. Both end in 利 (benefit), and 有 is have and 不 is not.
Beneficial and harmful. Both begin with 有 (have), and 益 is benefit and 害 is harm.
Legal and illegal. Both end in 法 (law). 合 means fit and 违 means go against.
Light and strong, for taste or colour. 淡 is thin and 浓 is thick.
Wide and narrow.
Soft and hard.
Make bigger and make smaller. 大 is big and 小 is small.
Make longer and make shorter. 长 is long and 短 is short.
Open and closed. 开 means open and 关 means close.
Modern times and ancient times. Both end in 代 (age). 现 is now and 古 is old.
In the past and nowadays. 前 is before and 今 is now.
Before this and after this. Both begin with 此 (this), and 前 is before and 后 is after.
Elementary and advanced. Both end in 级 (level), and 初 is first and 高 is high.
One person and a group. 个 is single and 集 is gather.
Slow and rapid.
Hard and comfortable.
Bright and dark.
Noisy and quiet.
Optimistic and negative.
Bold and timid. Both contain 胆 (courage), and 大 is big and 小 is small.
What you gain and what you put in. 收 is take in and 付 is pay out.
Admit and deny. Both end in 认 (recognise), and 承 is take on and 否 is no.
Not enough and enough. Both end in 足 (enough), and 不 is not and 充 is full.
Go to and come back. 前 is forward and 返 is come back.
The surface and the essence. 表 is outside and 本 is the root.
Clear and blurred.
Stand on your own and rely on others. 独 is alone and 靠 is lean on.
Join together and separate. 结 is tie and 分 is split.
Go forward and go back.
